title: Maria and Her Flashcards
text:
Maria has a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on one side. On the other side is the meaning. Maria reads a card every day.

Today Maria studies the word cat. She says the word out loud. Then she checks the back of the card. The answer is correct.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
Which word does Maria study today?
Why does Maria check the back of the card?
options: To see if her answer is right

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel after her answer is correct?

vocabulary.definition: a container with four sides, used to keep things
a single unit of language that has a meaning
what a word or sign means

paragraph_translations: Maria tem uma caixa de cartões de estudo. Cada cartão tem uma palavra de um lado. No outro lado está o significado. Maria lê um cartão todos os dias.
Hoje Maria estuda a palavra cat, que significa gato. Ela diz a palavra em voz alta. Depois, ela verifica o verso do cartão. A resposta está correta.
